# RandomPokemon.xyz

> RandomPokemon.xyz is a free, independent, unofficial fan-made Pokémon tool site centered on a browser-based Random Pokémon Generator. It covers 1,025 main species from Generations 1–9 and does not modify games or ROM files.

## Primary product

- [Random Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/): Generate 1–6 Pokémon, filter by generation, region, type, evolution stage, stats, and special categories, lock or reroll team members, inspect team weaknesses, save locally, and share a reproducible seeded result.

## Core tools

- [Favorite Pokémon Picker](https://randompokemon.xyz/favorite-pokemon-picker): Make head-to-head choices to rank and share a personal Top 10.
- [Pokémon Type Wheel](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon-type-wheel): Spin any selected pool of the 18 Pokémon types and immediately receive a random Pokémon from the winning type on the same page.
- [Pokémon Team Planner](https://randompokemon.xyz/team-planner): Build a team of up to six Pokémon and review type coverage, shared weaknesses, resistances, immunities, and broad gaps.
- [Compare Pokémon](https://randompokemon.xyz/compare-pokemon): Compare Pokémon stats, types, abilities, and defensive matchups side by side.

## Focused generators

- [Shiny Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-shiny-pokemon-generator): Select a species with Shiny artwork enabled; this does not simulate in-game Shiny odds.
- [Legendary Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-pokemon-legendary-generator): Generate from Pokémon classified as Legendary.
- [Starter Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-pokemon-starter-generator): Pick from traditional Grass, Fire, and Water starters, with optional Pikachu and Eevee.
- [Nuzlocke Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/random-nuzlocke-pokemon-generator): Create a game-agnostic, reproducible encounter or custom challenge rule.

## Generate by region

Region generators are a secondary cluster with region-specific Pokémon pools, starters, Legendary Pokémon, games, and presets.

- [Kanto Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/kanto-pokemon-generator)
- [Johto Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/johto-pokemon-generator)
- [Hoenn Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/hoenn-pokemon-generator)
- [Sinnoh Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/sinnoh-pokemon-generator)
- [Unova Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/unova-pokemon-generator)
- [Kalos Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/kalos-pokemon-generator)
- [Alola Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/alola-pokemon-generator)
- [Galar Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/galar-pokemon-generator)
- [Paldea Pokémon Generator](https://randompokemon.xyz/paldea-pokemon-generator)

## Pokédex and collections

- [Pokémon Pokédex](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon): Search all 1,025 main species and open detailed profiles with normal and Shiny artwork, types, abilities, stats, matchups, evolution families, related Pokémon, and team-building shortcuts.
- [Pokémon by Type](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon#pokemon-by-type): Open one of 18 indexable type collections at `/pokemon/type/{type}`.
- [Shiny Pokémon Pokédex](https://randompokemon.xyz/shiny-pokemon): Compare normal and Shiny artwork for all 1,025 main species. This is an artwork directory, not a Shiny-odds simulator.
- [Legendary Pokémon List](https://randompokemon.xyz/legendary-pokemon): Browse Pokémon classified as Legendary by generation; Mythical Pokémon are handled separately.
- [Starter Pokémon List](https://randompokemon.xyz/starter-pokemon): Browse the 27 traditional Grass, Fire, and Water first partners from Generations 1–9.

## Pokémon detail pages

All 1,025 default-form Pokémon detail pages are indexable, use self-canonical URLs, and are submitted in the dedicated Pokémon sitemap. The stable URL pattern is `/pokemon/{slug}`.

- [Pikachu](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon/pikachu)
- [Charizard](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon/charizard)
- [Tyranitar](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon/tyranitar)
- [Kyogre](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon/kyogre)
- [Froakie](https://randompokemon.xyz/pokemon/froakie)

## Published guides

- [Pokémon Tool Guides](https://randompokemon.xyz/blog): Index of published supporting content. Drafts, planned topics, and editorial roadmaps are not public pages.
- [Random Pokémon Generator vs Pokémon Randomizer](https://randompokemon.xyz/blog/random-pokemon-generator-vs-randomizer): Explains the difference between a browser-based Pokémon picker and software that changes a game or ROM.

## Sitemaps and indexation

- [Sitemap index](https://randompokemon.xyz/sitemap.xml)
- [Pages sitemap](https://randompokemon.xyz/sitemap-pages.xml): Homepage, core tools, focused generators, region generators, Pokédex hubs, type pages, and stable informational pages.
- [Pokémon sitemap](https://randompokemon.xyz/sitemap-pokemon.xml): The 1,025 default-form Pokémon detail pages.
- [Blog sitemap](https://randompokemon.xyz/sitemap-blog.xml): The Blog hub and actually published articles only.

Clean, stable pages are indexable and use self-canonical URLs. Query-string states for seeds, filters, searches, sorting, teams, sharing, and temporary results are user features rather than landing pages; they are excluded from sitemaps and receive `noindex, follow`.

## Data and scope notes

- Species and battle data are normalized from the open-source `@pkmn` data ecosystem.
- Height and English species-category metadata come from PokéAPI.
- Default sprites come from the PokéAPI sprites repository; supported alternate forms may use Pokémon Showdown sprites.
- The complete local dataset includes 1,025 default species plus supported alternate forms. Only the 1,025 default-form detail pages are submitted in the Pokémon sitemap.
- RandomPokemon.xyz is a browser-based generator and picker, not a Pokémon ROM randomizer.
- The site does not provide game-specific encounter tables, ROM patches, movesets, levels, or competitive team recommendations.
